name: hmi_rename_screen
description: Rename an exact screen in place within its group; existing siblings are never overwritten.

group_path.description: Exact containing group path; use an empty string for a root screen.

target_name.description: Exact HMI device, device-item, or software name; required when multiple targets exist.

on_conflict.description: Required conflict behavior; only 'fail' is supported.
